description: Third-party SwiftPM sources vendored into the repository so a plain clone builds VexSign.

localPatches.description: Sole off-main serial admission for local lifecycle and native sessions; bounded format-aware inspection/import/delete/export/install with reviewed digests.
Operation-scoped native handles, byte-snapshot parsing, record recheck and deterministic session cleanup; no autonomous pairing.
Bounded off-main endpoint diagnostics only, never socket-to-trust promotion.
No-follow bounded, rehashed AFC upload; exact target/expiry/OS checks and atomic Stop/command boundary; attempt-owned cleanup without deleting a possibly accepted payload; mutation gate retained.
Explicit-request positive-only CoreDevice inventory adaptation; mutation gate retained pending native binary/physical acceptance; no legacy pointer-array or private-inventory fallback.
Scoped native stream ownership and matching cleanup; cancellation never frees a handle used by a blocking FFI call.

localAdditions.description: Existing local storage owner hardened in place: bounded reads, canonical private roots, reviewed protected atomic lifecycle, migration and owned-name recovery.
Independently written flat classic/remote/combined record validator and redacted metadata; no conversion or device authorization.
Independently written bounded XML/binary preflight before Foundation/native parsing.
Conservative OS/format restrictions, sanitized typed errors and point-in-time device-query values; iOS 27+ on-device host pairing route added.
Single native admission slot retained until worker cleanup; bounded waiter and cooperative cancellation.
Scoped pinned-FFI client adapter for classic and iOS 27+ on-device RPPairing verified identity/service queries; simulator and unsupported routes blocked.
Identity-checked CoreDevice App Service inventory using typed client/list destructors, strict bounded UTF-8, explicit request and no absence inference; binary/partial-failure acceptance pending.
Independently written validated positive-only app metadata and opaque device/record binding; missing versions and omitted apps remain unknown.
Exact verified archive/metadata/expiry/OS target, atomic Stop-versus-submission control and command acknowledgement distinct from installation evidence.
On-device RPPairing host session wrapper: prepare/advertise/accept with explicit PIN callback, bounded timeout/cancellation, and no persistent trust writes.
